summary: Layer 1B expansion for the data-center power/cooling balance-of-plant node found one high-attention reference anchor and three underfollowed or less obvious US-listed candidates. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is for Vertiv as the recognized benchmark, Powell Industries as a medium-voltage switchgear beneficiary with explicit data-center orders, Modine as a data-center cooling supplier with a large long-term capacity agreement, and Atkore as an electrical-products supplier whose data-center exposure is plausible but needs deeper revenue-mix verification.
